body.en: An implicit parameter can be inferred from other arguments or from the expected type. Lean writes it as {x : nat} and fills it in by unification. Isabelle does the same by type inference.
body.zh: 能从别的参数或要的类型里读出来、所以不用写的参数叫隐式参数。Lean 里写成 {x : nat}，由合一填上；Isabelle 的类型推导做的是同一件事。

body.en: When lengths in types do not compute to the same, a value has to be transported across an equation: h ▸ v is the same vector under an equal length. This is the price of a ; Lean’s libraries often rewrite a definition just so the equality needed becomes definitional.
body.zh: 类型里的长度算不出一样时，要用一个等式把值搬运过去：h ▸ v 是同一个向量，换上一个相等的长度。这是的代价；Lean 的库里常常为此把定义换一种写法，让需要的相等变成定义相等。

body.en: A dependent type is a type that depends on a value: Vec n is vectors n long. In a function such as “∀x. Vec x → Vec (S x)”, the type of the result depends on the argument. With the length in the type, a mistake such as taking the first of an empty vector is refused when types are checked.
body.zh: 依赖类型是依赖一个值的类型：Vec n 是长 n 的向量。「∀x. Vec x → Vec (S x)」这样的函数，结果的类型依赖参数。长度写在类型里，取空向量第一个这样的错在检查类型时就被拒绝。

body.en: In Lean, proofs of the same proposition in Prop are considered equal (proof irrelevance). Values in Type, such as numbers, lists and vectors, can be used in computations.
body.zh: Prop 里的证明只关心有没有，两个证明算同一个（证明无关性）；Type 里的值（数、列表、向量）才是程序算的东西。

body.en: x + 0 = x is true, but addition recurses on its first number, and with x unknown the kernel gets stuck: it takes induction, a propositional equality. Using it to replace part of a type takes ▸; a needs nothing written, since the kernel computes it. Isabelle’s HOL has no layer of definitional equality: every equality is proved by rules or worked out by the simplifier.
body.zh: x + 0 = x 是对的，但加法按第一个数递归，x 不知道是几，核算不下去：它要用归纳证，这叫命题相等。用它换掉类型里的一处要写 ▸；不用写，核自己会算。Isabelle 的 HOL 没有定义相等这一层，所有相等都由规则证出，或者由化简器算出。

body.en: Before comparing two types, the kernel computes (unfolding definitions, putting in arguments, β-reduction), and what comes out alike counts as alike: definitional equality. 1 + 1 = 2 and 0 + x = x are proved by rfl, and a proof’s type can be read through it too. Which equalities are definitional depends on how the definitions are written.
body.zh: 核比较两个类型前，会按定义去算（展开定义、代入参数、β 归约），算出来一样的就算一样，这叫定义相等：1 + 1 = 2、0 + x = x 用 rfl 就证完，一个证明的类型也可以按它来换。哪些相等是定义相等，取决于定义是怎么写的。

body.en: Reflection keeps no certificate: write the sentences to decide as data, write a , prove once that it is right, and after that every problem needs only the kernel to run the program, the proof term being rfl. Lean’s decide and Coq’s ssreflect take this road. How fast depends on how the kernel computes, so some decision procedures (Lean’s omega, say) produce a proof for the kernel to check instead.
body.zh: 反射不留证书：把要判定的句子写成数据，写一个，证明一次它是对的，以后每一题只要核把程序算出来，证明项就是 rfl。Lean 的 decide、Coq 的 ssreflect 走的是这条路。算得快慢看核怎么算，所以也有判定过程（比如 Lean 的 omega）是生成证明交给核去查。

body.en: A program that, for every problem of a kind, stops and correctly answers yes or no is a decision procedure. Tautologies of propositional logic can be decided (work out the whole truth table); linear arithmetic and Presburger arithmetic have decision procedures too. First-order logic as a whole has none.
body.zh: 对一类问题里的每一个都能停下来、答对「是」还是「不是」的程序，叫判定程序。命题逻辑的永真式可以判定（把真值表算完）；线性算术、Presburger 算术也有判定程序。一阶逻辑整体没有。

body.en: Isabelle’s Isar (Wenzel, from 1999) writes proofs as text for people, a structured proof: have proves a sentence on the way, show the one wanted, assume, fix and obtain bring in an assumption, an arbitrary thing and a thing taken out, and proof … qed is a block. The method after each by does one small step, and the system checks every row. Lean writes much the same: have h : A := by …, show B, intro, obtain ⟨x, h⟩ := …, and calc for a chain of equations.
body.zh: Isabelle 的 Isar（Wenzel，1999 年起）把证明写成给人读的文本，叫结构化证明：have 先证一句，show 证出要证的那句，assume、fix、obtain 开出假设、任取的东西和拿出来的东西，proof … qed 是一块。每一句后面 by 的那个方法只负责一小步，系统检查每一句。Lean 的写法相近：have h : A := by …，show B，intro，obtain ⟨x, h⟩ := …，再加上把一串等式连起来的 calc。

body.en: A script, a proof term and a proof circuit are one proof: each row a part, each block a box. Large formalisations (the four colour theorem, the Kepler conjecture, the libraries mathlib and the AFP) are written this way: people write the structure and the lemmas, automation fills in the small steps.
body.zh: 脚本和证明项、证明电路是同一个证明：每一行是一个元件，块是框。大型的形式化（四色定理、开普勒猜想、数学库 mathlib 和 AFP）都是这样写成的：人写结构和引理，自动化补中间的小步。

body.en: In Lean, a = b is a type too. The only way to make one is rfl (a = a), and the only way to use one is Eq.rec, written h ▸ p: h proves a = b and p a sentence about a, giving that sentence with some of its a’s replaced by b. Which ones is said by a function fun x => …, the motive; Lean can usually read it off the sentence to prove. Symmetry and transitivity are built from these two: h ▸ rfl, k ▸ h.
body.zh: 在 Lean 里，a = b 也是一个类型。造它只有 rfl（a = a），用它只有 Eq.rec，写作 h ▸ p：h 证 a = b，p 证一句关于 a 的话，就得到把其中几处 a 换成 b 的那句。换哪几处，由一个函数 fun x => … 说清，这个函数叫动机；Lean 多半能从要证的那句里把它读出来。对称、传递都由这两样拼出：h ▸ rfl、k ▸ h。

body.en: A proof of “∀x. P(x)” is a function whose argument is not a proof but a thing: give it t and it gives back a proof of P(t). The type of the result varies with the argument, so it is a dependent function, its type written Π x, P x, in Lean simply ∀ x, P x. ∃ corresponds to the dependent pair (Σ type): a thing, and a proof that it fits.
body.zh: 「∀x. P(x)」的证明是一个函数，参数不是证明，而是一样东西：给它 t，它还你 P(t) 的证明。结果的类型跟着参数变，所以叫依赖函数，它的类型写作 Π x, P x，Lean 里就写 ∀ x, P x。∃ 对应的是依赖的一对（Σ 类型）：一样东西，和它满足那句话的证明。

body.en: A function taking a pair and one taking its arguments one at a time can each be rewritten as the other: A ∧ B → C and A → (B → C) give each other. Turning the first into the second is currying, named after Haskell Curry. In proof assistants functions of several arguments and rules of several premises are all written to take them one at a time.
body.zh: 吃一对的函数和一个一个吃的函数可以互相改写：A ∧ B → C 和 A → (B → C) 互相推得出。把前者换成后者叫柯里化，得名于 Haskell Curry。证明助手里多参数的函数和多前提的规则，都写成一个一个吃的样子。

body.en: Take the detours (brought in, then at once used up) out of a proof term one by one until none is left, and what remains is the normal form. Every proof term of intuitionistic logic comes to a normal form, the same whichever detour goes first (strong normalisation and confluence). A normal proof uses only what appears in the sentence it proves, the starting point of Gentzen’s and Prawitz’s proof theory.
body.zh: 把证明项里的弯路（刚引入就消去）一处处拿掉，直到一处都不剩，得到的是正规形式。直觉主义逻辑的每个证明项都化得成正规形式，而且不管先拿哪一处，结果都一样（强正规化、合流）。正规的证明只用到要证的那句里出现过的东西，这是 Gentzen 和 Prawitz 证明论的出发点。

body.en: A proof written as an expression is its proof term: a given is a name, Apply is p q, the assumption box fun h => …, Join ⟨a, b⟩. By the , it is a program as well, whose type is the sentence it proves. A proof term kept can be checked again by anyone with another checker.
body.zh: 把一个证明写成一个式子，就是它的证明项：已知是名字，套用是 p q，假设框是 fun h => …，拼起来是 ⟨a, b⟩。按，它同时是一个程序，类型就是它证的那句话。证明项留下来，谁都可以拿另一个检查器复查。

body.en: The Curry–Howard correspondence: a sentence is a type, and a proof of it is a program (a term) of that type. A proof of “A → B” is a function, of “A ∧ B” a pair, of “A ∨ B” a tagged value; ⊥ is the empty type with no values, and “¬A” is “A → ⊥”; a proof of “∀x. …” is a function taking a thing, and a proof of “∃x. …” a thing paired with a proof about it.
body.zh: Curry–Howard 对应：一句话就是一个类型，它的证明就是这个类型的一个程序（项）。「A → B」的证明是函数，「A ∧ B」的证明是一对，「A ∨ B」的证明是带标签的值，⊥ 是没有任何值的空类型，「¬A」就是「A → ⊥」；「∀x. …」的证明是吃一样东西的函数，「∃x. …」的证明是一样东西和关于它的证明配成的一对。

body.en: The proof board’s rules match one for one: Apply is function application, the assumption box is λ, joining and splitting are making a pair and taking a component, and cases is branching on the tag. So checking a proof is checking a type.
body.zh: 证明板上的规则也一一对上：套用是函数应用，假设框是 λ，拼起来和拆开是造一对和取分量，分情况是按标签分支。所以检查证明就是检查类型。

body.en: Proof by contradiction has no program: none can conjure a proof of A out of “A cannot fail”. So intuitionistic logic is exactly the part programs can do, and classical logic must add proof by contradiction or excluded middle as an axiom.
body.zh: 反证法没有对应的程序：没有哪个程序能从「A 不会不成立」变出 A 的证明。所以直觉主义逻辑正好是程序能做到的那部分，经典逻辑要把反证法或排中律另外当公理加上。

body.en: (fun h => b) a works out to “b with h replaced by a”: β-reduction, calling a function. In a proof, a made and at once applied is a detour; β-reduction takes it out, proving the same sentence.
body.zh: (fun h => b) a 算成「b 里的 h 换成 a」，这一步叫 β 归约，就是调用一个函数。证明里，一个刚造出来就被套用，是一处弯路；β 归约把它拿掉，证的还是同一句。

body.en: fun h => b (also written λ h => b) makes a function: given an h, give b. This is λ-abstraction, as written in Church’s λ-calculus of the 1930s. The assumption box is λ: its assumption is the parameter h, its proof the body b, and outside comes a proof of A → B.
body.zh: fun h => b（也写成 λ h => b）造一个函数：拿到一个 h，就给出 b。这叫 λ 抽象，是 Church 在 1930 年代的 λ 演算里的写法。假设框就是 λ：框里的假设是参数 h，框里的证明是函数体 b，框外得到 A → B 的证明。

value.zh: 「下雨或者地面湿」只在没下雨、地面也不湿时为假。先用手头的门接出同样的真值，再把电路封装成「或」门。
value.en: “It rains or the ground is wet” is false only when there’s no rain and the ground is dry. Build that behavior with the gates you have, then pack the circuit into an Or gate.

value.zh: 分别用非门得到「没下雨」和「地面不湿」。用与门把两者接成「既没下雨，地面也不湿」，再用一个非门把整句取反。
value.en: Use a Not gate on each input to get “it isn’t raining” and “the ground is dry”. Join them with And, then use one more Not gate to negate the whole statement.

value.zh: 最后一个非门接在与门的输出上，再把非门的输出接到「这句话」。
value.en: Feed the And output into the last Not gate, then wire its output to This statement.

brief.zh: 用刚做好的或门计算「现在下着雨，或者刮着风」的真值。
brief.en: Use your new Or gate to evaluate “It’s raining or it’s windy.”

value.zh: 「或者」只需要至少一边为真。下雨又刮风时，或门也输出真。
value.en: Or needs at least one true input. The gate still outputs true when it’s both raining and windy.

value.zh: 「如果下雨，地面就会湿」只在下了雨、地面却不湿时为假。没下雨，或者地面是湿的，这条条件句就为真。
value.en: “If it rains, the ground gets wet” is false only when it rains and the ground stays dry. The conditional is true whenever it doesn’t rain or the ground is wet.

value.zh: 用非门把「下雨」变成「没下雨」，再用或门接上「地面湿」。把或门的输出接到「这句话」。
value.en: Use Not to turn “it rains” into “it doesn’t rain”. Join that with “the ground is wet” using Or, then wire its output to This statement.

value.zh: 「地面湿」直接接到或门，只有「下雨」需要先过非门。
value.en: Wire “the ground is wet” straight into Or. Only “it rains” goes through Not first.

brief.zh: 有人看见地面是湿的，就说「如果地面是湿的，那刚才就下过雨」。用刚做好的若则门算这句话的真值。
brief.en: Someone sees a wet yard and says, “If the ground is wet, it must have rained.” Evaluate that claim with your new If–then gate.

hint.zh: 先看「如果」后面是哪件事，把它接到若则门的第一个输入。
hint.en: Wire the condition that follows “if” into the first input of the If–then gate.

value.zh: 对调条件与结果，只有在「地面湿、没下雨」这一行，新句子为假。若则门的两个输入有顺序。
value.en: With the condition and result swapped, the new claim is false only when the ground is wet and it didn’t rain. Input order matters for an If–then gate.

value.zh: 若则门有方向。把两个方向用「或者」接在一起，会出现哪几行为假？
value.en: An If–then gate has a direction. If you join the two directions with Or, which rows can come out false?

value.zh: 用两个若则门分别接出「如果下雨，地面就湿」和「如果地面湿，就下过雨」。用或门合并两路输出，再运行真值表。
value.en: Use two If–then gates for “If it rains, the ground is wet” and “If the ground is wet, it rains”. Join their outputs with Or and run the truth table.

value.zh: 把「下雨」和「地面湿」按相反的顺序接入两个若则门。
value.en: Wire “it rains” and “the ground is wet” into the two If–then gates in opposite orders.

value.zh: 两条条件句至少有一条为真，所以输出列全是真。这种句子叫<wiki-ref to="tautology"></wiki-ref>。你搭的电路现在可以作为「永真」门使用。
value.en: At least one conditional is true in every case, so the output column is all true. A sentence like this is a <wiki-ref to="tautology"></wiki-ref>. Your circuit is now available as an Always True gate.

desc.zh: 把两个相反方向的若则用或门接在一起。无论 a 和 b 取什么值，输出都是真。
desc.en: The two directions of If–then joined by Or. The output is true for every pair of inputs.

value.zh: 刚才用「或者」要求两个方向至少有一个成立。现在看看，换成「并且」要求两个方向都成立时，输出会怎样。
value.en: Or required at least one direction to hold. This time, use And to require both directions and see what happens to the output.

value.zh: 还是用两个若则门，一个从「下雨」接到「地面湿」，另一个反过来。用与门合并两路输出，再运行真值表。
value.en: Use two If–then gates again, one from “it rains” to “the ground is wet” and one in the reverse direction. Join their outputs with And and run the truth table.

value.zh: 对照两列输入，找出它们同真或同假的行。
value.en: Compare the two input columns. Find the rows where their values match.

value.zh: 两个方向都成立，两个命题就同真同假。这叫<wiki-ref to="equivalence"></wiki-ref>，写作 ↔。你刚搭的电路就是一个等价门。
value.en: When both directions hold, the inputs have matching truth values. This is <wiki-ref to="equivalence"></wiki-ref>, written ↔. The circuit you built is an Equivalent gate.

brief.zh: 用卡片把记录中的两项说法拼成一个公式，让公式表示两项都成立。
brief.en: Use the cards to build one formula that says both claims in the report hold.

say.zh: 值班员在记录上写道：「只要下雨，院子的地面就会湿。刚才下了雨，可院子里的地面还是干的。」
say.en: The caretaker wrote in the log: “Whenever it rains, the ground in the yard gets wet. It rained just now, but the ground was still dry.”

hint.zh: 先翻译「只要下雨，院子的地面就会湿」。这是一条什么样的条件句？
hint.en: Start with “Whenever it rains, the ground in the yard gets wet”. Which connective expresses that condition?

hint.zh: 后一句说雨确实下了，地面却没湿。再用一个「并且」把两句连起来。
hint.en: The second sentence says it rained and the ground stayed dry. Join the two sentences with another And.

value.en: Does the rain report add up?

value.zh: 一份雨情记录写了两件事。要判断它们能不能同时成立，先把每件事翻译成逻辑语言，弄清连接词各管哪一部分。
value.en: A rain report makes two claims. To see if both can hold, first translate them into logic. Work out what each connective joins or negates.

value.zh: 再用真值电路计算公式。每个基本命题对应一个输入，每个连接词对应一个门。真值表把输入的各种真假组合各跑一遍。
value.en: Then evaluate the formula with a truth circuit. Each basic proposition becomes an input and each connective becomes a gate. The truth table runs the circuit once for each combination of inputs.

value.zh: 按刚才拼出的公式接线。运行真值表，看看有没有哪一行能让记录里的两项说法都成立。
value.en: Wire the formula you just built. Run the truth table and see whether any row makes both claims in the report true.

value.zh: 可以回到「拼句子」查看译文。按公式的层次接线，每个门先接好自己要用的输入，再接到外层的门。
value.en: Revisit Build a formula to check your translation. Wire the inner connectives first, then feed their outputs into the outer ones.

value.zh: 四行都是假。只要真的下了雨，地面就会湿，这条条件句和「下了雨，地面还是干的」无法同时为真。每一行都为假的公式叫<wiki-ref to="contradiction"></wiki-ref>。
value.en: All four rows are false. The rule says rain makes the ground wet, so it can’t hold alongside a report of rain leaving the ground dry. A formula that is false on every row is a <wiki-ref to="contradiction"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: 你在见过：每一行都假的句子。这里用 ⊥ 表示假。
value.en: You met a in : a sentence false on every row. Here we write falsity as ⊥.

value.en: Knights and Knaves: The First Clue

t.zh: 你登上一座岛，遇到两位岛民 a 和 b。这里的骑士永远说真话，无赖永远说假话。两人都属于其中一种。
t.en: You arrive on an island and meet two residents, a and b. Every islander is either a knight, who always tells the truth, or a knave, who always lies.

t.zh: a 先开口了。把「a 是骑士」和他说的那句话放进同一个公式，就能用真值表筛出符合岛上规则的身份组合。
t.en: a speaks first. Put “a is a knight” and what a says into one formula, then use the truth table to find the identities that fit the island’s rules.

value.zh: 两人同为骑士或同为无赖，都说得通。只有一句证词，还无法分清是哪一种。接下来的谜题里，你会用同样的方法检验更复杂的证词。
value.en: Both could be knights, or both could be knaves. This clue leaves two possibilities. In the next puzzles, you’ll use the same method to check more complicated statements.
Wire the formula you just built. The circuit should output true when a’s statement “b is a knight” matches a’s identity.

value.en: You met the in : a sentence false on every row, written ⊥.
value.zh: 里见过：每一行都假的句子，写作 ⊥。

body.en: A proposition false on every row of a classical truth table is a contradiction, for example “it rains ∧ ¬it rains”. The prover uses ⊥ as a distinguished false proposition; a contradictory formula is not necessarily syntactically identical to ⊥.
body.zh: 在经典真值表的每一行都为假的命题称为矛盾式，例如「下雨 ∧ ¬下雨」。证明器中的 ⊥ 是一个表示矛盾的特殊命题；不能把任意矛盾式都当作与 ⊥ 语法相同。

body.en: In this prover, ¬A is defined as A → ⊥. To prove ¬A, one can assume A and derive ⊥.
body.zh: 在本证明器中，¬A 定义为 A → ⊥。因此，证明 ¬A 可以通过假设 A 并从中推出 ⊥ 完成。

value.zh: 它由两半用与门接成，右边一半本身也是一个「并且」。

t.en: Apply uses the rule \(\llbracket A\to B; A\rrbracket\Longrightarrow B\). Once you have B, you can use it to derive another conclusion. The elimination rule puts both steps into one rule.

after.zh: 消去规则是 \(\llbracket A\to B; A; \llbracket B\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R\)。前两条前提给出 B，第三条接着从 B 推出 R。
after.en: The elimination rule is \(\llbracket A\to B; A; \llbracket B\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R\). The first two premises give B, and the third derives R from B.

brief.zh: R 代表任意命题。规则板已固定前提 \(A\to B\) 和结论 R。补上其余前提，写出消去规则。
brief.en: R stands for any proposition. The premise \(A\to B\) and the conclusion R are fixed. Add the remaining premises to write the elimination rule.

body.en: An elimination rule explains how to use a proposition with a : A follows from \(A\land B\); B follows from \(A\to B\) and A; and \(A\lor B\) supports reasoning by cases. Using a proposition in a proof does not consume it. Harmony requires elimination rules to correspond appropriately to the ways that connective is introduced.
body.zh: 消去规则说明如何使用带有某个的命题：由 \(A\land B\) 可得 A，由 \(A\to B\) 和 A 可得 B；对 \(A\lor B\) 则可以分类讨论。证明中使用一个命题并不会消耗它。引入与消去规则之间的和谐要求消去规则与该连接词的引入方式相协调。

body.en: An introduction rule has a new in its conclusion: Join gets \(A\land B\) from A and B, Choose gets \(A\lor B\) from A, the assumption box gets \(A\to B\). To prove a sentence, its outermost connective says which introduction rule to use.
body.zh: 引入规则的结论里多出一个：拼起来由 A、B 得 \(A\land B\)，二选一由 A 得 \(A\lor B\)，假设框得 \(A\to B\)。要证一句话，看它最外面的连接词，就知道用哪条引入规则。

body.en: Every rule in the game is written \mark{open-bracket}premises\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} conclusion, the way Isabelle writes it: \mark{open-bracket}it rains; it is windy\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} it rains \mark{and} it is windy says “\(\text{with proofs of it rains and it is windy},\text{you have a proof of it rains}\land \text{it is windy}\)”. In a rule, the letters A and B stand for any sentence and R for any conclusion.
body.zh: 游戏里的规则都写成 \mark{open-bracket}前提\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} 结论，这是 Isabelle 的写法：\mark{open-bracket}下雨; 刮风\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} 下雨 \mark{and} 刮风 说的是「有了下雨和刮风的证明，就得到下雨 \mark{and} 刮风的证明」。规则里的字母 A、B 代表任何一句话，R 代表任何结论。

body.en: The double arrow \mark{entails} and the single arrow \mark{implies} are not on one level. \mark{implies} is inside a sentence: \(A\to B\) is itself a sentence, which can be proved, assumed and wired into other parts. \mark{entails} is outside sentences and relates proofs: with these, you have that. The kernel joins them: the assumption box turns “assume A, prove B” into a sentence \(A\to B\), and Apply goes back, from \(A\to B\) and A to B. Isabelle keeps the two levels apart: \mark{entails} belongs to its meta-logic Pure, \mark{implies} to the logic HOL.
body.zh: 双箭头 \mark{entails} 和单箭头 \mark{implies} 不在一层。\mark{implies} 在句子里面：\(A\to B\) 本身是一句话，可以被证明、被假设、接进别的元件。\mark{entails} 在句子外面，说的是证明之间的关系：有了这些，就有那个。两者靠证明核连在一起：假设框把「假设 A 证出 B」变成一句 \(A\to B\)，套用反过来，用 \(A\to B\) 和 A 得到 B。Isabelle 把这两层分开：\mark{entails} 属于它的元逻辑 Pure，\mark{implies} 属于 HOL 这门逻辑。

body.en: Lean has one arrow. A way to make is written And.intro : a → b → a ∧ b: a rule is an implication, and the way to make is its proof (the Curry–Howard correspondence), so a rule is applied just as a sentence with \mark{implies} is. The two notations say one thing: \mark{open-bracket}A; B\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C is \(A\to B\to C\).
body.zh: Lean 只有一个箭头。引入规则写成 And.intro : a → b → a ∧ b：规则就是一句蕴含，引入规则就是它的证明（Curry–Howard 对应），所以规则能直接像一句 \mark{implies} 那样套用。两种写法说的是同一件事：\mark{open-bracket}A; B\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C 就是 \(A\to B\to C\)。

body.en: When writing a declaration in the game, only the outermost layer of \mark{entails} is written: an intro rule is “\mark{open-bracket}premise; premise\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} conclusion”, each premise a whole sentence; a premise that needs premises of its own says so inside its sentence, with \mark{implies} and \mark{forall}, as in \mark{open-bracket}\(\forall y.\, y\) below \(x\to y\) reachable\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} x reachable. So writing a declaration and writing a lemma take one format: one conclusion, a few intro rules, each a row of premises side by side, with whatever is complex kept inside the statements. Isabelle’s own way writes that inner layer as a rule too, \mark{open-bracket}\mark{meta-all}y. \mark{open-bracket}y below x\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} y reachable\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} x reachable, so that the kernel splits it into subgoals when the rule is used, with no for-any box and assumption box needed first to prove a sentence with \mark{implies}. The two can be turned into each other and say the same; the game takes the first so the rules a player writes have one format and read simply. The elimination rule made from them still follows Isabelle, its premises with premises and things of their own: the kernel writes it, not the player. Lean has one arrow and writes intro rules as a constructor’s arguments, nearer the game’s way.
body.zh: 游戏里写声明时，只写最外面一层 \mark{entails}：一条引入规则是「\(\llbracket \text{前提};\text{前提}\rrbracket \Longrightarrow \text{结论}\)」，每个前提都是一句完整的话；前提要是自己还需要别的前提，就用 \mark{implies} 和 \mark{forall} 写进句子里，比如 \mark{open-bracket}\(\forall y.\, y\)比x小 \mark{implies} y可达\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} x可达。这样一来，写声明和写引理是同一种格式：一个结论，几条引入规则，每条一串并列的前提，复杂的部分都留在命题内部。Isabelle 真实的写法会把这一层也写成规则，\mark{open-bracket}\mark{meta-all}y. \mark{open-bracket}y比x小\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} y可达\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} x可达，好处是用规则时证明核直接把它拆成子目标，不必先用任取框和假设框证出一句 \mark{implies} 。两种写法可以互相转换，表达能力一样；游戏选前一种，是为了让玩家亲手写的规则格式统一、读起来简单。生成的消去规则仍照 Isabelle 的写法，前提可以带自己的前提和任取：那是证明核写的，不是玩家写的。Lean 只有一种箭头，引入规则写成构造子的参数，和游戏的写法更接近。

body.en: An inference rule specifies how conclusions follow from premises. For example, Apply derives B from \(A\to B\) and A. Letters represent proposition schemata and can be consistently instantiated as the rule permits. On the proof board, inputs represent premises and the output represents the conclusion.
body.zh: 推理规则说明怎样从前提推导结论。例如，套用由 \(A\to B\) 和 A 推出 B。规则的字母表示命题模式，可以按规则允许的方式一致替换。证明板上的规则元件以输入端表示前提、输出端表示结论。

why: Remove the superseded proof-board lesson

title.en: Read the rule behind a part

t.en: You can write out what a proof-board part does as a <wiki-ref to="rule"></wiki-ref>: “\mark{open-bracket}premises\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} conclusion”. The left side tells you what to wire in. The right side tells you what follows. The letters A and B can stand for any sentences, and each occurrence of the same letter stands for the same sentence.
t.zh: 证明板上的线可以换成文字来读。一条<wiki-ref to="rule"></wiki-ref>写作「\(\llbracket \text{前提}\rrbracket \Longrightarrow \text{结论}\)」。\mark{entails} 左边是元件要接到的东西，右边是能推出的结论。字母 A、B 可以换成任意命题，同一个字母在一条规则里要换成同一句。

t.en: The rule for <part-ref to="part:mp"></part-ref> is “\(\llbracket A\to B;A\rrbracket \Longrightarrow B\)”. The rule for the <part-ref to="part:impI"></part-ref> is “\(\llbracket \llbracket A\rrbracket \Longrightarrow B\rrbracket \Longrightarrow A\to B\)”. The inner \mark{open-bracket}A\mark{close-bracket} is available only inside the box. Prove B under that assumption, and the box gives you \(A\to B\).
t.zh: <part-ref to="part:mp"></part-ref>的规则是「\(\llbracket A\to B\text{；}A\rrbracket \Longrightarrow B\)」。<part-ref to="part:impI"></part-ref>的规则是「\(\llbracket \llbracket A\rrbracket \Longrightarrow B\rrbracket \Longrightarrow A\to B\)」。内层 \mark{open-bracket}A\mark{close-bracket} 只在框里有效：在这个假设下证出 B，出框才得到 \(A\to B\)。

t.en: You can also package several proof steps as one part. For example, <part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref> gives “\mark{open-bracket}\(A\to B\); \(B\to C\)\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} \(A\to C\)”. Wire these three rules and see what each premise connects to on the board.
t.zh: 几步证明也能封装成一块元件。比如<part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>给出「\mark{open-bracket}\(A\to B\)；\(B\to C\)\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} \(A\to C\)」。试着按这三条规则接线，观察每条规则的前提在板上接到哪里。

after.en: The components box now shows the rules your proof parts give. The premises tell you what to wire in, and the conclusion tells you what comes out. Apply and the assumption box belong to the kernel. Chain gets its rule from a proof you built. Next, give “and” rules of its own.
after.zh: 从现在起，可以在元件箱查看证明元件给出的规则。前提写清要接什么，结论写清会得到什么。套用和假设框是证明核已有的规则，串联的规则则来自你搭过的证明。接下来试试怎样给「并且」加入新规则。

brief.en: Match the premises of “\(\llbracket A\to B;A\rrbracket \Longrightarrow B\)” to the two givens, then wire Apply to get the conclusion.
brief.zh: 把「\(\llbracket A\to B\text{；}A\rrbracket \Longrightarrow B\)」里的前提对上板上的两条已知，用套用接出结论。

hint.en: Find the given with \mark{implies} first. Its condition must match the other given.
hint.zh: 先找含有 \mark{implies} 的那条已知。它的条件要和另一条已知对上。

brief.en: Follow the assumption box rule. Assume A inside the box, then use that assumption and the two givens to prove C.
brief.zh: 按假设框的规则，先在框里假设 A，然后用这条假设和两条已知证出 C。

hint.en: Both givens have condition A. Apply each to A and see what one more application would give you.
hint.zh: 两条已知的条件都是 A。先分别套用它们，看看还差哪一次套用。

brief.en: Use Chain to join the two “if” statements, then apply the result to the third given.
brief.zh: 先用「串联」把两条「若…则…」接成一条，再用第三条已知套用它。

hint.en: The conclusion of the first given must match the condition of the second.
hint.zh: 第一条已知的结论，要和第二条已知的条件一致。

why: Replace the implication exercise with a standalone disjunction elimination trial

title.zh: 试用 · 写出「或」的消去规则
title.en: Trial · Write the rule for eliminating Or

t.zh: 假如你知道同学会坐公交或地铁到校，想证明他能在八点前到校，就得考虑两条路线。命题 \(A\lor B\) 也一样。要用它推出结论，就分别考虑 A 成立和 B 成立的情况。
t.en: Suppose a classmate will take the bus or the train. To show they can arrive by eight, consider each route. The same idea works for \(A\lor B\). To use it, consider the case where A holds and the case where B holds.

t.zh: 「或」有两条引入规则。证出 A 可以得到 \(A\lor B\)，证出 B 也可以得到 \(A\lor B\)。
t.en: Or has two introduction rules. A proof of A gives \(A\lor B\), and so does a proof of B.

after.zh: 消去规则是 \(\llbracket A\lor B;\ \llbracket A\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R;\ \llbracket B\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R\)。当引入规则列全了证明一个命题的构造方式，就能按这些方式生成分类讨论的消去规则。每条引入规则对应一个分支，两种方式都能得到同一个 R，所以手里的 \(A\lor B\) 足以接上这段证明。
after.en: The elimination rule is \(\llbracket A\lor B;\ \llbracket A\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R;\ \llbracket B\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R\). When the introduction rules describe all the ways to construct a proof, a case analysis rule can be generated from them. Each introduction rule gives one branch. Both branches reach the same R, so \(A\lor B\) is enough to use that case analysis.

brief.zh: R 代表任意命题。规则板已固定前提 \(A\lor B\) 和结论 R。用两张「假设……并推出……」卡补齐两种情况，分别说明怎样在该情况成立时推出 R。
brief.en: R stands for any proposition. The premise \(A\lor B\) and conclusion R are fixed. Add two premises using the “assume … and derive …” card to show how each case leads to R.

hint.zh: 一张卡假设 A，另一张卡假设 B。两张卡都要推出 R。
hint.en: Assume A on one card and B on the other. Both cards must derive R.

t.en: Apply uses the rule \(\llbracket A\to B; A\rrbracket\Longrightarrow B\). Once you have B, you can use it to derive another conclusion. The elimination rule puts both steps into one rule.
t.zh: 套用规则是 \(\llbracket A\to B; A\rrbracket\Longrightarrow B\)。拿到 B 后，后续的证明还可以使用 B 得到别的结论。消去规则把这两步写进同一条规则。

after.en: The elimination rule is \(\llbracket A\to B; A; \llbracket B\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R\). The first two premises give B, and the third derives R from B.
after.zh: 消去规则是 \(\llbracket A\to B; A; \llbracket B\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R\rrbracket\Longrightarrow R\)。前两条前提给出 B，第三条接着从 B 推出 R。

brief.en: R stands for any proposition. The premise \(A\to B\) and the conclusion R are fixed. Add the remaining premises to write the elimination rule.
brief.zh: R 代表任意命题。规则板已固定前提 \(A\to B\) 和结论 R。补上其余前提，写出消去规则。

hint.en: What else does Apply need to give B? Which sentence should you assume next, and which should you derive?
hint.zh: 套用还要接入哪一句才能得到 B？接下来要假设哪一句，并推出哪一句？

body.en: An elimination rule explains how to use a proposition with a : A follows from \(A\land B\); B follows from \(A\to B\) and A; and \(A\lor B\) supports reasoning by cases. Using a proposition in a proof does not consume it. Harmony requires elimination rules to correspond appropriately to the ways that connective is introduced.
body.zh: 消去规则说明如何使用带有某个的命题：由 \(A\land B\) 可得 A，由 \(A\to B\) 和 A 可得 B；对 \(A\lor B\) 则可以分类讨论。证明中使用一个命题并不会消耗它。引入与消去规则之间的和谐要求消去规则与该连接词的引入方式相协调。

brief.zh: 需求：「\(A\leftrightarrow B\)」：两个方向的「若…则…」都已证出，才能引入。写出「当且仅当」的声明。

hint.en: Does the requirement need both at once, or is either enough?

ops.value: 假设框用来证明「若 A，则 B」。在「假设」栏设定 A，然后在框内以 A 为临时前提证明 B。将证出的 B 接到「结论」端口，框外便得到 A \mark{implies} B。

value.en: A box, with A set on the part. Inside, A may be used as an assumption; prove B there and wire it to “Conclusion”, and the part gives A \mark{implies} B.
value.zh: 带一个框，A 在元件上设定。框内可以使用假设 A；框内证出 B 并接到「结论」，元件输出 A \mark{implies} B。

why: Use standard terminology for disjunction introduction settings

ops.value: <level-ref to="decl-or"></level-ref>声明了「或者」，并给出了两条析取引入规则。已证得命题 A 时，可以补充任意命题 B，得到 \(A\lor B\) 或 \(B\lor A\)。在<part-ref to="part:orI"></part-ref>元件中，填写「补充析取项」，再设置「补充项位置」，即可选择相应的引入规则。

<level-ref to="decl-or"></level-ref> defines “or” and gives its two introduction rules. From a proven proposition A, you can add any proposition B to obtain \(A\lor B\) or \(B\lor A\). On the <part-ref to="part:orI"></part-ref> part, enter the Added disjunct and set its Position to select the corresponding rule.
先用「今天是周六」引入 \(\text{今天是周六}\lor\text{今天是周日}\)。「补充析取项」选「今天是周日」，「补充项位置」选「右」。再以所得析取式为输入，这次将「补充项位置」选为「左」。

value.zh: 先用「今天是周六」引入 \(\text{今天是周六}\lor\text{今天是周日}\)。「补充析取项」选「今天是周日」，「补充项位置」选「右」。再以所得析取式为输入，这次将「补充项位置」选为「左」。

value.zh: <level-ref to="decl-or"></level-ref>声明了「或者」，随之有了<part-ref to="part:orI"></part-ref>：有了一句话，「\(\text{它}\lor \text{任意一句}\)」就成立。在元件上选它放在左边还是右边，就是选两条引入规则中的哪一条；另一边是哪句话，也在元件上选。

why: Build machine-board lessons with direct rewrite and backward cards

t.zh: 机器板的「输入」给出每个案例的已知和待证目标，「预期」显示这次要得到的状态。同一块电路会处理每个案例。
t.en: On the machine board, Input shows each case’s givens and goal. Expected shows the state you need to reach. The same circuit handles every case.

t.zh: 案例给出一条等价式，如 \(A \leftrightarrow B\)。改写卡会在目标中找到一处 \(A\)，把它换成 \(B\)。
t.en: Each case gives an equivalence such as \(A \leftrightarrow B\). The rewrite card finds an occurrence of \(A\) in the goal and replaces it with \(B\).

after.zh: 改写换掉了目标里匹配的一处，已知和目标的其余部分照旧。
after.en: The rewrite replaced one matching occurrence. The givens and the rest of the goal stayed the same.

brief.zh: 放一张改写卡，将它接在「输入」和「预期」之间，再运行。
brief.en: Place a rewrite card, wire it between Input and Expected, and run the board.

hint.zh: 从「输入」的输出口连到改写卡的输入口，再把卡片的输出接到「预期」。
hint.en: Connect the output of Input to the card’s input, then connect the card’s output to Expected.

t.zh: 要证 \(A \to B\)，可以先把 \(A\) 放进已知，再证 \(B\)。把假设框规则倒着用，机器就会做这一步。
t.en: To prove \(A \to B\), you can add \(A\) to the givens and then prove \(B\). Applying the assumption-box rule backwards makes the machine take that step.

after.zh: 逆用从规则的结论匹配当前目标，再把证明推进到规则的前提。这里新增一条已知，也留下了一个新目标。
after.en: A backward rule matches its conclusion to the current goal and leaves its premises to be proved. Here the rule adds a given and leaves one new goal.

brief.zh: 用逆用假设框卡展开每个案例的目标。
brief.en: Use the backward assumption-box card to open up each case’s goal.

hint.zh: 运行后，比较 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 分别出现在已知还是目标里。
hint.en: After running the board, check where \(A\) and \(B\) appear in the output.

title.en: Close a goal with a given

t.zh: 如果待证目标已经在已知里，就可以用「引用已知」直接证完它。
t.en: If the goal appears among the givens, Cite a given can close it immediately.

after.zh: 匹配成功后，这个目标就从待证列表里消失了。
after.en: Once a given matches, the goal disappears from the list of remaining goals.

brief.zh: 用一张逆用卡证完每个案例。
brief.en: Use one backward card to finish every case.

hint.zh: 「引用已知」会找与当前目标相同的句子。
hint.en: Cite a given looks for a sentence identical to the current goal.

t.zh: 这次等价式已经在已知里。看看能不能先把「如果」后的条件换成与结论相同的句子。

after.zh: 先改写整条目标中的条件，再打开假设框，引用新增的已知即可得证。

after.en: Using the assumption box backwards changes both the available givens and the current goal. Whether a rewrite can run depends on the proof state it receives.

t.zh: 已知里有等价式，也有改写后的整句。目标里出现了两处要换的内容。
t.en: The givens contain an equivalence and the complete sentence you need to reach. The goal has two occurrences to replace.

after.zh: 改写按先整体、再从左到右查找子式的顺序，每次只替换第一处匹配。
after.en: A rewrite checks the whole expression first, then its subexpressions from left to right. Each card replaces only the first match.

brief.zh: 证完每个案例。运行后查看两处分别在哪一步被改写。

hint.zh: 每张改写卡只换一处。等目标和已知里的整句一致，再引用它。

t.zh: 机器要证的是一条「并且」。一边已经在已知里，另一边要借助等价式。
t.en: The goal is a conjunction. One side is already given, and the other needs an equivalence.

after.en: Both goals left by backward Join must be proved. Each time a goal closes, the next one becomes current.

ops.name: allE
ops.value: 接入 \(\forall x.\, P(x)\)，选定对象 \(t\)，得到 \(P(t)\)。

ops.name: allI
ops.value: 在元件上为任意对象取名 \(a\)，在框内证明 \(P(a)\) 并接到「结论」，框外得到 \(\forall x.\, P(x)\)。\(a\) 不能出现在未解除的假设中。

ops.name: andE
ops.value: 接入 \(A \land B\)，两个输出口分别得到 \(A\) 和 \(B\)。

ops.name: andE
ops.value: 接入 \(A \land B\)，两个输出口分别得到 \(A\) 和 \(B\)。\(A \leftrightarrow B\) 表示 \((A \to B) \land (B \to A)\)，也可以这样拆解。

ops.name: axK
ops.value: 在元件上选定两句 \(A\)、\(B\)，输出 \(A \to (B \to A)\)。

ops.name: axS
ops.value: 在元件上选定三句 \(A\)、\(B\)、\(C\)，输出 \((A \to (B \to C)) \to ((A \to B) \to (A \to C))\)。

ops.name: botE
ops.value: 由矛盾 \(\bot\) 得到元件上选定的任意一句。

ops.name: chain
ops.value: 由 \(A \to B\) 和 \(B \to C\) 得到 \(A \to C\)。

ops.name: clausify
ops.value: 把待证句子的否定加入已知，把已知化为合取范式并消去 \(\exists\)，再拆成子句。

ops.name: exE
ops.value: 接入 \(\exists x.\, P(x)\)，在元件上为存在的对象取名 \(a\)。框内可以假设 \(P(a)\)；证出 \(C\) 并接到「结论」后，框外得到 \(C\)。\(C\) 中不能出现 \(a\)，\(a\) 也不能出现在未解除的假设中。

ops.name: exI
ops.value: 接入 \(P(t)\)，以 \(t\) 为例得到 \(\exists x.\, P(x)\)。只有一个相符的存在命题时自动输出；有多个时，在元件上选择要得出的命题。

ops.name: gAnd
ops.value: \(a \land b\)：两个输入都是真，才输出真；否则输出假。

ops.name: gIff
ops.value: \(a \leftrightarrow b\)：\(a\) 和 \(b\) 同真或同假时输出真；一真一假时输出假。

ops.name: gImp
ops.value: \(a \to b\)：只在 \(a\) 是真、\(b\) 是假时输出假；其余都输出真。

ops.name: gNot
ops.value: \(\lnot a\)：输入是真，输出假；输入是假，输出真。

ops.name: gOr
ops.value: \(a \lor b\)：两个输入里至少有一个是真，就输出真；都是假，输出假。

ops.name: impI
ops.value: 假设框用来证明「若 A，则 B」。在「假设」栏设定 \(A\)，然后在框内以 \(A\) 为临时前提证明 \(B\)。将证出的 \(B\) 接到「结论」端口，框外便得到 \(A \to B\)。

ops.name: lem
ops.value: 在元件上选定一句 \(A\)，输出 \(A \lor \lnot A\)。

ops.name: metis
ops.value: 把目标化为子句，找出推出 \(\bot\) 的证书，再由核重放检查：通过则目标证完；证书没有通过检查时，元件失败。

ops.name: mp
ops.value: 由 \(A \to B\) 和 \(A\) 得到 \(B\)。

ops.name: mp
ops.value: 由 \(A \to B\) 和 \(A\) 得到 \(B\)。\(\lnot A\) 即 \(A \to \bot\)，所以由 \(\lnot A\) 和 \(A\) 得到矛盾 \(\bot\)。

ops.name: orE
ops.value: 接入 \(A \lor B\)，在两个框中分别假设 \(A\)、\(B\)。两个框都证出同一句 \(C\) 并接到各自的「结论」时，元件输出 \(C\)。

ops.name: orI
ops.value: 接入 \(A\)，选定另一句 \(B\) 和它的位置，得到 \(A \lor B\) 或 \(B \lor A\)；不需要证明 \(B\)。

ops.name: oracle
ops.value: 快速证明器：两条子句间的相反文字一次全部消去，逐轮进行，直到推出 \(\bot\) 或不再产生新子句。每条新子句也记下两条父子句。

ops.name: raa
ops.value: 由 \(\lnot \lnot A\) 得到 \(A\)（双重否定消去）。

ops.name: refl
ops.value: 在元件上选定一样东西 \(t\)，得到 \(t = t\)。

ops.name: replay
ops.value: 子句集中有 \(\bot\) 时，把推出 \(\bot\) 的步骤交给核检查：用到的每条输入子句须由某条已知拆出；每一步须由它的两条父子句（变量按合一结果代入）经自建 auto 证出。全部通过，拆出这些子句的目标即证完；某一步不通过，指出是哪一步。

ops.name: res
ops.value: 接入两条子句，一条含 \(A\)，另一条含 \(\lnot A\)，位置不限：消去这一对，其余部分用「或者」连起来；什么都不剩时得到矛盾 \(\bot\)。一次只消一对。

ops.name: rewrite
ops.value: 接入 \(s = t\) 和一句含 \(s\) 的话；元件标出这句话里的每一处 \(s\)，勾选的几处换成 \(t\)。

ops.name: saturate
ops.value: 逐轮归结，直到推出 \(\bot\)，或不再产生新子句。

ops.name: skolem
ops.value: 消去第一个目标的已知中所有的 \(\exists\)：外层没有 \(\forall\) 的，像实例框一样取出那一样东西；在 \(\forall\) 之内的，换成一个新函数，参数是外层所有 \(\forall\) 的变量（\(sk1(x)\)……）。已知须先化为否定范式。

ops.name: toClauses
ops.value: 第一个目标须为 \(\bot\)：把它的已知拆成子句。每条已知须为合取范式；拆开「并且」，每串「或者」成为一条子句，去掉 \(\forall\)，变量按「对所有」理解。

ops.name: allE
ops.value: Connect \(\forall x.\, P(x)\) and choose an object \(t\) to obtain \(P(t)\).

ops.name: allI
ops.value: Name an arbitrary object \(a\) on the part. Prove \(P(a)\) inside the box and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain \(\forall x.\, P(x)\) outside. \(a\) must not occur in any open assumption.

ops.name: andE
ops.value: Connect \(A \land B\) to get \(A\) and \(B\) at separate outputs.

ops.name: andE
ops.value: Connect \(A \land B\) to get \(A\) and \(B\) at separate outputs. \(A \leftrightarrow B\) means \((A \to B) \land (B \to A)\) and can be split in the same way.

ops.name: axK
ops.value: Choose two sentences \(A\) and \(B\) on the part; gives \(A \to (B \to A)\).

ops.name: axS
ops.value: Choose three sentences \(A\), \(B\) and \(C\) on the part; gives \((A \to (B \to C)) \to ((A \to B) \to (A \to C))\).

ops.name: botE
ops.value: From the contradiction \(\bot\), gives whatever sentence is chosen on the part.

ops.name: chain
ops.value: From \(A \to B\) and \(B \to C\), gives \(A \to C\).

ops.name: exE
ops.value: Connect \(\exists x.\, P(x)\) and name the existing object \(a\) on the part. Inside the box, \(P(a)\) may be assumed. Prove \(C\) and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain \(C\) outside. \(a\) must not appear in \(C\) or in any open assumption.

ops.name: exI
ops.value: Connect \(P(t)\) to obtain \(\exists x.\, P(x)\), with \(t\) as a witness. If exactly one existential statement fits, it is selected automatically; if several fit, choose the conclusion on the part.

ops.name: gAnd
ops.value: \(a \land b\): outputs true only when both inputs are true; otherwise false.

ops.name: gIff
ops.value: \(a \leftrightarrow b\): outputs true when \(a\) and \(b\) are both true or both false; false when one is true and the other false.

ops.name: gImp
ops.value: Outputs false only when \(a\) is true and \(b\) is false; true otherwise.

ops.name: gNot
ops.value: \(\lnot a\): true in gives false out; false in gives true out.

ops.name: impI
ops.value: A box, with \(A\) set on the part. Inside, \(A\) may be used as an assumption; prove \(B\) there and wire it to “Conclusion”, and the part gives \(A \to B\).

ops.name: lem
ops.value: Choose a sentence \(A\) on the part; gives \(A \lor \lnot A\).

ops.name: metis
ops.value: Turns the goal into clauses, finds a certificate that reaches \(\bot\) and has the kernel replay it: if it passes, the goal is closed; if the certificate fails the check, the part fails.

ops.name: mp
ops.value: From \(A \to B\) and \(A\), gives \(B\). \(\lnot A\) is \(A \to \bot\), so from \(\lnot A\) and \(A\), gives the contradiction \(\bot\).

ops.name: orE
ops.value: Connect \(A \lor B\) and assume \(A\) and \(B\) in separate boxes. When both prove the same \(C\) and connect it to their respective “Conclusion” ports, the part outputs \(C\).

ops.name: orI
ops.value: Connect \(A\) and choose another statement \(B\) and its position to get \(A \lor B\) or \(B \lor A\). \(B\) need not be proved.

ops.name: oracle
ops.value: A fast prover: it cancels all complementary literals between two clauses at once, round after round until \(\bot\) appears or no new clause does. It too records the two parents of each new clause.

ops.name: refl
ops.value: Choose a thing \(t\) on the part; gives \(t = t\).

ops.name: replay
ops.value: When the clause set contains \(\bot\), the steps to \(\bot\) go to the kernel: each input clause used must come from a hypothesis, and each step must be proved from its two parents (variables instantiated by unification) by Own auto. If all pass, the goal the clauses came from is proved; otherwise it names the failing step.

ops.name: res
ops.value: Wire in two clauses, one holding \(A\) and the other \(\lnot A\), in any position: that pair is cancelled and what is left is joined with “or”; when nothing is left, gives the contradiction \(\bot\). One pair at a time.

ops.name: rewrite
ops.value: Wire in \(s = t\) and a sentence containing \(s\); the part marks each \(s\) in it, and the ticked ones become \(t\).

ops.name: saturate
ops.value: Resolves round after round until \(\bot\) appears or no new clause does.

ops.name: skolem
ops.value: Removes every \(\exists\) from the first goal’s hypotheses: one with no \(\forall\) outside is taken out as the instance box does; one under a \(\forall\) becomes a new function of all the enclosing \(\forall\) variables (\(sk1(x)\) …). The hypotheses must be in negation normal form first.

ops.name: toClauses
ops.value: The first goal must be \(\bot\): its hypotheses are split into clauses. Each must be in CNF; conjunctions are split, each disjunction becomes a clause, universal quantifiers are dropped and variables read as universally quantified.

ops.name: clausify
ops.value: Adds the negated goal to the hypotheses, brings them to CNF, removes the existential quantifiers and splits them into clauses.

value.en: Wire in s = t and a sentence containing s; the part marks each s in it, and the ticked ones become t.
value.zh: 接入 \(s = t\) 和一句含 \(s\) 的话；元件标出这句话里的每一处 \(s\)，勾选的几处换成 \(t\)。

value.en: Wire in two clauses, one holding A and the other \mark{not}A, in any position: that pair is cancelled and what is left is joined with “or”; when nothing is left, gives the contradiction \mark{bottom}. One pair at a time.
value.zh: 接入两条子句，一条含 \(A\)，另一条含 \(\lnot A\)，位置不限：消去这一对，其余部分用「或者」连起来；什么都不剩时得到矛盾 \(\bot\)。一次只消一对。

value.en: When the clause set contains \mark{bottom}, the steps to \mark{bottom} go to the kernel: each input clause used must come from a hypothesis, and each step must be proved from its two parents (variables instantiated by unification) by Own auto. If all pass, the goal the clauses came from is proved; otherwise it names the failing step.
value.zh: 子句集中有 \(\bot\) 时，把推出 \(\bot\) 的步骤交给核检查：用到的每条输入子句须由某条已知拆出；每一步须由它的两条父子句（变量按合一结果代入）经自建 auto 证出。全部通过，拆出这些子句的目标即证完；某一步不通过，指出是哪一步。

value.en: Choose a thing t on the part; gives t = t.
value.zh: 在元件上选定一样东西 \(t\)，得到 \(t = t\)。
由 \(\lnot \lnot A\) 得到 \(A\)（双重否定消去）。

value.en: A fast prover: it cancels all complementary literals between two clauses at once, round after round until \mark{bottom} appears or no new clause does. It too records the two parents of each new clause.
value.zh: 快速证明器：两条子句间的相反文字一次全部消去，逐轮进行，直到推出 \(\bot\) 或不再产生新子句。每条新子句也记下两条父子句。

value.en: Connect A and choose another statement B and its position to get A \mark{or} B or B \mark{or} A. B need not be proved.
value.zh: 接入 \(A\)，选定另一句 \(B\) 和它的位置，得到 \(A \lor B\) 或 \(B \lor A\)；不需要证明 \(B\)。

value.en: Connect A \mark{or} B and assume A and B in separate boxes. When both prove the same C and connect it to their respective “Conclusion” ports, the part outputs C.
value.zh: 接入 \(A \lor B\)，在两个框中分别假设 \(A\)、\(B\)。两个框都证出同一句 \(C\) 并接到各自的「结论」时，元件输出 \(C\)。

value.en: From A \mark{implies} B and A, gives B. \mark{not}A is A \mark{implies} \mark{bottom}, so from \mark{not}A and A, gives the contradiction \mark{bottom}.
value.zh: 由 \(A \to B\) 和 \(A\) 得到 \(B\)。\(\lnot A\) 即 \(A \to \bot\)，所以由 \(\lnot A\) 和 \(A\) 得到矛盾 \(\bot\)。

value.en: From A \mark{implies} B and A, gives B.
value.zh: 由 \(A \to B\) 和 \(A\) 得到 \(B\)。

value.en: Turns the goal into clauses, finds a certificate that reaches \mark{bottom} and has the kernel replay it: if it passes, the goal is closed; if the certificate fails the check, the part fails.
value.zh: 把目标化为子句，找出推出 \(\bot\) 的证书，再由核重放检查：通过则目标证完；证书没有通过检查时，元件失败。

value.en: From A \mark{implies} (A \mark{implies} B), gives A \mark{implies} B.
Choose a sentence A on the part; gives A \mark{or} \mark{not}A.
value.zh: 在元件上选定一句 \(A\)，输出 \(A \lor \lnot A\)。

value.en: A box, with A set on the part. Inside, A may be used as an assumption; prove B there and wire it to “Conclusion”, and the part gives A \mark{implies} B.
value.zh: 假设框用来证明「若 A，则 B」。在「假设」栏设定 \(A\)，然后在框内以 \(A\) 为临时前提证明 \(B\)。将证出的 \(B\) 接到「结论」端口，框外便得到 \(A \to B\)。

value.en: \mark{not}a: true in gives false out; false in gives true out.
value.zh: \(\lnot a\)：输入是真，输出假；输入是假，输出真。

value.en: Outputs false only when a is true and b is false; true otherwise.
value.zh: \(a \to b\)：只在 \(a\) 是真、\(b\) 是假时输出假；其余都输出真。

value.en: a \mark{iff} b: outputs true when a and b are both true or both false; false when one is true and the other false.
value.zh: \(a \leftrightarrow b\)：\(a\) 和 \(b\) 同真或同假时输出真；一真一假时输出假。

value.en: a \mark{and} b: outputs true only when both inputs are true; otherwise false.
value.zh: \(a \land b\)：两个输入都是真，才输出真；否则输出假。

value.en: Connect P(t) to obtain \mark{exists}x. P(x), with t as a witness. If exactly one existential statement fits, it is selected automatically; if several fit, choose the conclusion on the part.
value.zh: 接入 \(P(t)\)，以 \(t\) 为例得到 \(\exists x.\, P(x)\)。只有一个相符的存在命题时自动输出；有多个时，在元件上选择要得出的命题。

value.en: Connect \mark{exists}x. P(x) and name the existing object a on the part. Inside the box, P(a) may be assumed. Prove C and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain C outside. a must not appear in C or in any open assumption.
value.zh: 接入 \(\exists x.\, P(x)\)，在元件上为存在的对象取名 \(a\)。框内可以假设 \(P(a)\)；证出 \(C\) 并接到「结论」后，框外得到 \(C\)。\(C\) 中不能出现 \(a\)，\(a\) 也不能出现在未解除的假设中。

value.en: From A \mark{implies} B and B \mark{implies} C, gives A \mark{implies} C.
value.zh: 由 \(A \to B\) 和 \(B \to C\) 得到 \(A \to C\)。

value.en: From the contradiction \mark{bottom}, gives whatever sentence is chosen on the part.
value.zh: 由矛盾 \(\bot\) 得到元件上选定的任意一句。

value.en: Choose three sentences A, B and C on the part; gives (A \mark{implies} (B \mark{implies} C)) \mark{implies} ((A \mark{implies} B) \mark{implies} (A \mark{implies} C)).
value.zh: 在元件上选定三句 \(A\)、\(B\)、\(C\)，输出 \((A \to (B \to C)) \to ((A \to B) \to (A \to C))\)。

value.en: Choose two sentences A and B on the part; gives A \mark{implies} (B \mark{implies} A).
value.zh: 在元件上选定两句 \(A\)、\(B\)，输出 \(A \to (B \to A)\)。

value.en: Connect A and B to get A \mark{and} B.
Connect A \mark{and} B to get A and B at separate outputs. A \mark{iff} B means (A \mark{implies} B) \mark{and} (B \mark{implies} A) and can be split in the same way.
value.zh: 接入 \(A \land B\)，两个输出口分别得到 \(A\) 和 \(B\)。\(A \leftrightarrow B\) 表示 \((A \to B) \land (B \to A)\)，也可以这样拆解。

value.en: Connect A \mark{and} B to get A and B at separate outputs.
value.zh: 接入 \(A \land B\)，两个输出口分别得到 \(A\) 和 \(B\)。

value.en: Name an arbitrary object a on the part. Prove P(a) inside the box and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain \mark{forall}x. P(x) outside. a must not occur in any open assumption.
value.zh: 在元件上为任意对象取名 \(a\)，在框内证明 \(P(a)\) 并接到「结论」，框外得到 \(\forall x.\, P(x)\)。\(a\) 不能出现在未解除的假设中。

value.en: Connect \mark{forall}x. P(x) and choose an object t to obtain P(t).
value.zh: 接入 \(\forall x.\, P(x)\)，选定对象 \(t\)，得到 \(P(t)\)。

value.en: The first goal must be \mark{bottom}: its hypotheses are split into clauses. Each must be in CNF; conjunctions are split, each disjunction becomes a clause, \mark{forall}s are dropped and variables read as universally quantified.

value.en: Removes every \mark{exists} from the first goal’s hypotheses: one with no \mark{forall} outside is taken out as the instance box does; one under a \mark{forall} becomes a new function of all the enclosing \mark{forall} variables (sk1(x) …). t.zh: 之前，你从已知出发，连接规则，一步步推到要证明的结论。现在，你要设计一个证明器，让它从待证目标出发，倒着寻找能证明它的规则。
t.en: Earlier, you connected rules from the givens until you reached the conclusion. Now you will design a proof assistant that starts with a goal and works backwards to find rules that can prove it.

t.zh: 最简单的情况是：目标已经在已知里。这时「照抄」就能直接证完它。
t.en: The simplest case is a goal already among the givens. Cite a given can prove it immediately.

value.zh: 证明器从目标出发，只要找到完全相同的已知，就能确定这一目标已证完。按目标匹配规则，机器可以逐步寻找要证的内容，并对不同案例重复同一套步骤，更适合自动化；遇到复杂目标时，还需要更多规则。
value.en: The proof assistant starts from the goal and closes it when it finds an identical given. Matching rules to goals lets a machine work through what remains to be proved and repeat the same steps across cases, making automation easier. More complex goals still need more rules.

value.zh: 之前用代换规则改写已证的句子；现在用同一条规则改写待证目标。改写卡从已知中找一条用得上的等价式，如 \(A \leftrightarrow B\)，把目标里的一处 \(A\) 换成 \(B\)。
value.en: Earlier, you used substitution to rewrite a proved sentence. Now use the same rule on a goal. The rewrite card finds an applicable equivalence, such as \(A \leftrightarrow B\), among the givens and replaces one occurrence of \(A\) in the goal with \(B\).

value.zh: 用来证明的规则也一一对上：套用是函数应用，假设框是 λ，拼起来和拆开是造一对和取分量，分情况是按标签分支。所以检查证明就是检查类型。
value.en: The rules used in a proof match one for one: Apply is function application, the assumption box is λ, joining and splitting are making a pair and taking a component, and cases is branching on the tag. So checking a proof is checking a type.

value.zh: 推理规则说明怎样从前提推导结论。例如，套用由 \(A\to B\) 和 A 推出 B。规则的字母表示命题模式，可以按规则允许的方式一致替换。证明时使用的规则元件以输入端表示前提、输出端表示结论。
value.en: An inference rule specifies how conclusions follow from premises. For example, Apply derives B from \(A\to B\) and A. Letters represent proposition schemata and can be consistently instantiated as the rule permits. In a proof, a rule part’s inputs represent premises and its output represents the conclusion.

value.zh: <level-ref to="decl-and"></level-ref>声明了「并且」，证明时随之多了两块元件：<part-ref to="part:andI"></part-ref>是它唯一的引入规则；<part-ref to="part:andE"></part-ref>是由它生成的消去规则，两个输出口分别给出左边和右边。每个连接词都有一组引入规则和一组消去规则，这样组织的规则体系叫<wiki-ref to="natural"></wiki-ref>。
value.en: <level-ref to="decl-and"></level-ref> declared “and”, and two parts became available for proofs: <part-ref to="part:andI"></part-ref>, its one introduction rule, and <part-ref to="part:andE"></part-ref>, the elimination rule made from it, whose two outputs give the left and the right. Every connective has its introduction and elimination rules; a system of rules organised this way is called <wiki-ref to="natural"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: 按照证明器的证书，重新搭建证明。
value.en: Rebuild the proof from the proof assistant’s certificate.
